_comment: The one machine-readable statement of the self-hosted runner pool's size.
scripts/check-pool-facts.sh checks every prose statement in the tree
against this file, and `bash scripts/check-pool-facts.sh --live` checks
this file against the runners API. See that script's header for why the
number lives here and not in the API: listing self-hosted runners needs
repo administration rights, and `administration` is not one of the
workflow GITHUB_TOKEN's permission scopes at all, so an in-lane query
cannot be made to work by granting anything.
measured: 2026-09-08, repos/claymore666/docker-net-dhcp/actions/runners: 16 dhcp-ci-1..16 carrying `dhcp-ci`, plus rpi-arm64-1 carrying `dhcp-ci-arm64` (17 registered in total, which is the number the API prints and the number this file exists to stop anyone quoting as the pool).
